name: @lmthing/dsh-space-format
description: The canonical LMThing space-format parser — the unified merge of the three prior independent implementations (sdk/org/libs/core/src/spaces, mcp/src/format, and this package's own earlier JS port). No Cordis dependency. Authored in native TypeScript, run directly via Node's built-in type stripping (no build step) — the same pattern mcp/ already uses. See dsh/PROGRESS.md (Part A1) for the full design-decision record.
